payload.source: Publisher release records in the policy-as-versioned organisations
payload.note: Four dated statements, each read off a public release record in this estate's own organisations, so every entry here is checkable by opening its URL. That is the whole assertion this feed makes: something was said, on that date, and it was read there. What any of it MEANS for an organisation -- which component it touches, whether it moves an evolution position, whether it prices -- is a claim the classify-and-judge skill produces with a human at the keyboard, lands as a reviewed PR on that adopter's overlay, and is never a field in this payload.
